source_note: Hand-built sample set — real, currently-existing course titles and providers, written from general knowledge (not scraped or fetched live). Fallback for the missing Coursera/Udemy MCP connectors, per user instruction. Treat as representative, not verbatim listings. estimated_hours is a rough hand estimate for path-fitting purposes, not a scraped/official figure.

courses.title: IBM Data Engineering Professional Certificate
courses.description: A multi-course program covering Python, SQL, relational and NoSQL databases, data warehousing, ETL pipelines, Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, and Spark, aimed at learners with no prior data engineering background.

courses.title: Google Cloud Data Engineering Professional Certificate
courses.description: Prepares learners to design and build data processing systems on Google Cloud, covering BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, data pipeline orchestration, and machine learning pipeline integration.

courses.title: Data Engineering, Big Data, and Machine Learning on GCP Specialization
courses.description: Covers building data pipelines and analytical solutions with GCP tools, including Dataproc, BigQuery, and Dataflow, with a focus on scaling data processing for machine learning workloads.

courses.title: The Complete SQL Bootcamp
courses.description: Hands-on SQL course using PostgreSQL, covering queries, joins, aggregations, subqueries, and window functions, aimed at beginners with no SQL background.

courses.title: Apache Spark with Scala/Python - Hands On with Big Data
courses.description: Teaches distributed data processing with Apache Spark, covering RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, and running Spark jobs at scale on real datasets.

courses.title: Apache Airflow: The Hands-On Guide
courses.description: Covers building, scheduling, and monitoring data pipelines with Apache Airflow, including DAG design, operators, sensors, and best practices for production workflows.

courses.title: Apache Kafka Series - Learn Apache Kafka for Beginners
courses.description: Introduces event streaming with Apache Kafka: producers, consumers, topics, partitions, and building real-time data pipelines.

courses.title: Python for Everybody Specialization
courses.description: An introductory sequence covering Python fundamentals, data structures, web scraping, databases, and basic data visualization, built for complete beginners.

courses.title: Docker and Kubernetes: The Complete Guide
courses.description: Covers containerizing applications with Docker and orchestrating them with Kubernetes, relevant to deploying and scaling data pipeline infrastructure.

courses.title: Data Warehousing for Business Intelligence Specialization
courses.description: Covers dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, ETL design, and OLAP concepts for building analytical data warehouses.

courses.title: Analytics Engineering with dbt
courses.description: Teaches building modular, tested, and documented data transformation pipelines using dbt (data build tool) on top of a cloud data warehouse.

courses.title: NoSQL Database Systems Concepts and Design with MongoDB
courses.description: Covers document-oriented database design and querying with MongoDB, including schema design trade-offs between relational and NoSQL systems.
